prompts.title: Request developer mode
prompts.reason: Rabbit must approve developer mode before its supported bootloader-unlock setting is available.
prompts.action: Use rabbit's official process, wait for approval, and enable bootloader unlocking in rabbithole before connecting the R1.
prompts.expected: Rabbithole shows that developer mode is approved and bootloader unlocking is enabled.
prompts.warning: Do not continue based only on submitting the request; wait for the actual approval state.
prompts.cancel: Stop without connecting to or changing the R1.

prompts.title: Back up the R1
prompts.reason: A stock-to-JackRabbit bootstrap is expected to erase local device data; a verified signed release must declare the exact data policy before installation.
prompts.action: Back up anything you need and assume local data will be erased unless the selected verified release explicitly declares preserve.
prompts.expected: Anything important is stored somewhere other than the R1.
prompts.warning: No acknowledgement can override the signed release's data policy.
prompts.cancel: Stop without connecting to or changing the R1.

prompts.title: Prepare the hardware
prompts.reason: Stable power and a data-capable cable are required before any USB device check.
prompts.action: Charge the R1, use a known data-capable USB cable, power the device off, and disconnect it.
prompts.expected: The R1 is charged, powered off, and disconnected from the computer.
prompts.warning: Do not connect the cable until the installer asks for it.

prompts.title: Use rabbit's FASTBOOT entry
prompts.reason: Native preloader entry is not enabled until it passes the exact host and device evidence gate.
prompts.action: Open rabbit's official page and choose only Enter Fastboot Mode. Connect the powered-off R1 when that page asks.
prompts.expected: The physical R1 screen says FASTBOOT.
prompts.warning: Never choose Flash Stock ROM. Return here after FASTBOOT appears.
prompts.cancel: Close the official page and leave the R1 unchanged if FASTBOOT does not appear.

prompts.title: Let JackRabbit enter FASTBOOT
prompts.reason: A stock R1 must transition through its exact MediaTek preloader identity before native fastboot is available.
prompts.action: Power the R1 off and disconnect it. Continue this prompt, then connect the cable when the CLI says it is waiting for the R1 preloader.
prompts.expected: The CLI reports that the eight-byte FASTBOOT command was sent and the physical R1 screen says FASTBOOT.
prompts.warning: Connect exactly one R1. The CLI accepts only USB identity 0e8d:2000 and sends only FASTBOOT at 115200 baud.
